alternateName._instruction: Enter any other known full name of this person.

associatedAccount._instruction: Add the information about web service accounts held by this person.

contactInformation._instruction: Add the contact information of this person.

digitalIdentifier._instruction: Add all globally unique and persistent digital identifier of this person.

familyName._instruction: Enter the family name, surname, or equivalent of this person.

givenName._instruction: Enter the given name(s) of this person, or a name chosen in place of the given name. At least one of the names should be spelled out in full; initials may be used for the others.

preferredName._instruction: Enter the person’s preferred way to write their name in a professional context. It is recommended to place given before family name separated by space.
